description: This file defines the IConnectionIssueListener interface used for monitoring connection issues in log-consistent grains within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IConnectionIssueListener
classes.description: An interface for handling connection issues and their resolution in Orleans grains.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssue
methods.description: Method invoked when a connection problem occurs, allowing modification of retry delay.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssueResolved
methods.description: Method invoked when a previously reported connection issue has been resolved.
